verdict.rationale: Evidence shows PostHog can capture events via HTTP API from any source (posthog-docs-11) and sync external data sources like Stripe/Postgres/Salesforce into a queryable warehouse (posthog-docs-9, posthog-docs-29), which could be used to backfill historical data, but there's no explicit documentation of a bulk/historical import tool, CSV import, or migration path from other analytics tools (e.g., GA, Mixpanel, Amplitude). Missing for 10: dedicated historical-import feature or migration guide, explicit support for backdated event timestamps, documented CSV/bulk upload tooling, and any case study of migrating from a competitor tool.
